description: Symbolic Wenzl Schur principal-specialisation y_λ(q) for n=6 (deferred cancel). Each y_λ = s_λ(q)/Z where s_λ and Z are rational functions in q (Q^r is itself rational in q via the Markov-parameter relation). Cross-validated against the bridge y-lambda-mpfr-witness.json at q_0 to better than 1e-12; tr_M(deuteron) at q_0 reproduces the canonical 0.388286... value to machine precision.
note_on_closed_forms: Symbolic closed-form expressions for s_λ and Z exist (rational in q via the Markov-parameter relation Q^r = z_W/(1-Q+z_W) with Q=q^2, z_W = q·z, z = 1/(√q + 1/√q)) but are too large to print usefully. Use schur_principal_symbolic(list(λ)) in markov_weights_symbolic.py to regenerate them on demand.
